description: Return the full contents of any public skill by owner/name slug: the SKILL.md text plus every companion file for packs, ready to write to disk. If the skill calls other skills (for example it says to call the Skill tool with another skill's name), their files come back in the same answer under dependencies: write each one under its own folder next to this skill. Skills that are only related are listed under related, without files. Skills are plain-text instructions an agent reads on demand; nothing executes, and every listed skill has passed SkillMD's safety review.

slug.description: Skill identifier as owner/name, e.g. anthropic/pdf

name: skillmd_download

dependencies.description: Skills this skill calls, nearest first: write each one's files under its own folder next to this skill. Absent when there are none.

files.description: Its files, in the same shape as files above

kind.description: How the skill calls it: skill_tool or invoke

via.description: The skill that calls it (this one, or another dependency)

files.description: Every file in the skill, SKILL.md first

note.description: How to treat this entry when content is not inlined

path.description: Relative path inside the skill folder

source_url.description: Fetch URL for large or binary companions not inlined

related.description: Skills only referred to (see, link), without files; download one by its slug if it is wanted. Absent when there are none.

title: Download skill files
